description: This file defines the ProspectLink class, which extends Link2, and customizes the getJoin method to modify how relationships between campaign prospects and other entities are joined in database queries within the SuiteCRM platform. It is specific to handling campaign target list relations with customized join logic.

classes.name: ProspectLink
classes.description: A subclass of Link2 that overrides the getJoin method to implement custom join logic for campaign prospect relationships.

methods.name: getJoin
methods.description: Overrides the getJoin method to produce custom SQL join clauses for campaign prospect relationships based on specific relationship types and join parameters.
